description: Creates a new customer in Stripe, required for creating charges or subscriptions; an email is highly recommended for customer communications.

address.description: The customer's billing address, provided as a dictionary where both keys and values are strings. This address can be used for tax calculation, shipping, and fraud prevention. Common keys include: `line1` (street address, P.O. box, or c/o), `line2` (apartment, suite, unit, or building), `city`, `state` (state, province, or region), `postal_code` (ZIP or postal code), and `country` (a two-letter ISO country code, e.g., 'US', 'GB'). All keys are optional. Can be provided as either a dictionary or a JSON string.
address.title: Address

description.description: An arbitrary string that you can attach to a customer object for your internal reference (e.g., notes about the customer). This is not visible to the customer.
description.title: Description

email.description: The customer's primary email address, used by Stripe for sending invoices, receipts, and other important communications.
email.title: Email

name.description: The customer's full name or the name of the business.
name.title: Name

phone.description: The customer's primary phone number. Include the country code for international numbers (e.g., +1 for the USA).
phone.title: Phone

name: create_customer

city.description: City, district, suburb, town, or village.
city.title: City

line1.description: Address line 1 (e.g., street, PO Box, or company name).
line1.title: Line1

line2.description: Address line 2 (e.g., apartment, suite, unit, or building).
line2.title: Line2

available.description: A hash of all cash balances available to this customer.
available.title: Available

customer.description: The ID of the customer that this cash balance belongs to.
customer.title: Customer

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'cash_balance'.
object.title: Object

settings.description: Settings controlling the behavior of the customer's cash balance.
settings.title: Settings

reconciliation_mode.description: The configuration for how funds that land in the customer cash balance are reconciled. One of: automatic, manual.
reconciliation_mode.title: Reconciliation Mode

using_merchant_default.description: Whether the reconciliation mode is using the account-level default.
using_merchant_default.title: Using Merchant Default

balance.description: Current balance, if any, on the customer's account. A negative value indicates the customer has credit to apply to their next invoice, while a positive value indicates the customer has an amount owed that will be added to their next invoice. The balance does not refer to any unpaid invoices; it solely takes into account amounts that have yet to be successfully applied to any invoice. This balance is in the currency's smallest unit.
balance.title: Balance

cash_balance.description: The current funds being held by Stripe on behalf of the customer.
cash_balance.title: Cash Balance

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO code for the currency the customer can be charged in for recurring billing purposes.
currency.title: Currency

default_source.description: ID of the default payment source for the customer.
default_source.title: Default Source

delinquent.description: When the customer's latest invoice is billed by charging automatically, delinquent is true if the invoice's latest charge failed. When the customer's latest invoice is billed by sending an invoice, delinquent is true if the invoice isn't paid by its due date.
delinquent.title: Delinquent

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.
description.title: Description

discount.description: Describes the current discount active on the customer, if there is one.
discount.title: Discount

invoice_credit_balance.description: The current multi-currency balances, if any, being stored on the customer.
invoice_credit_balance.title: Invoice Credit Balance

invoice_prefix.description: The prefix for the customer used to generate unique invoice numbers.
invoice_prefix.title: Invoice Prefix

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: The customer's full name or business name.
name.title: Name

next_invoice_sequence.description: The suffix of the customer's next invoice number, e.g., 0001.
next_invoice_sequence.title: Next Invoice Sequence

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'customer'.
object.title: Object

preferred_locales.description: The customer's preferred locales (languages), ordered by preference.
preferred_locales.title: Preferred Locales

shipping.description: Mailing and shipping address for the customer. Appears on invoices emailed to this customer.
shipping.title: Shipping

sources.description: The customer's payment sources, if any.
sources.title: Sources

subscriptions.description: The customer's current subscriptions, if any.
subscriptions.title: Subscriptions

tax_exempt.description: Describes the customer's tax exemption status. One of none, exempt, or reverse. When set to reverse, invoice and receipt PDFs include the text 'Reverse charge'.
tax_exempt.title: Tax Exempt

test_clock.description: ID of the test clock this customer belongs to.
test_clock.title: Test Clock

checkout_session.description: The Checkout session that this coupon is applied to, if it is applied to a particular session in payment mode.
checkout_session.title: Checkout Session

customer.description: The ID of the customer associated with this discount.
customer.title: Customer

end.description: If the coupon has a duration of repeating, the date that this discount will end. If the coupon has a duration of once or forever, this attribute will be null.
end.title: End

id.description: The ID of the discount object.
id.title: Id

invoice.description: The invoice that the discount's coupon was applied to, if it was applied directly to a particular invoice.
invoice.title: Invoice

invoice_item.description: The invoice item id (or invoice line item id for invoice line items of type='subscription') that the discount's coupon was applied to, if it was applied directly to a particular invoice item or invoice line item.
invoice_item.title: Invoice Item

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'discount'.
object.title: Object

promotion_code.description: The promotion code applied to create this discount.
promotion_code.title: Promotion Code

source.description: Source details containing the coupon type and identifier.
source.title: Source

start.description: Date that the coupon was applied.
start.title: Start

subscription.description: The subscription that this coupon is applied to, if it is applied to a particular subscription.
subscription.title: Subscription

subscription_item.description: The subscription item that this coupon is applied to, if it is applied to a particular subscription item.
subscription_item.title: Subscription Item

type.description: The type of source. Value is 'coupon'.
type.title: Type

name.description: The name of the custom field.
name.title: Name

value.description: The value of the custom field.
value.title: Value

amount_tax_display.description: How line-item prices and amounts will be displayed with respect to tax on invoice PDFs.
amount_tax_display.title: Amount Tax Display

template.description: ID of the invoice rendering template to use for this customer's invoices.
template.title: Template

custom_fields.description: Default custom fields to be displayed on invoices for this customer.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

default_payment_method.description: ID of a payment method that's attached to the customer, to be used as the customer's default payment method for subscriptions and invoices.
default_payment_method.title: Default Payment Method

footer.description: Default footer to be displayed on invoices for this customer.
footer.title: Footer

rendering_options.description: Default options for invoice PDF rendering for this customer.
rendering_options.title: Rendering Options

data.description: Array of objects (payment sources, subscriptions, or tax IDs).
data.title: Data

has_more.description: True if this list has another page of items after this one that can be fetched.
has_more.title: Has More

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'list'.
object.title: Object

url.description: The URL where this list can be accessed.
url.title: Url

automatic_tax.description: Surfaces if automatic tax computation is possible given the current customer location information. One of: failed, supported, unsupported.
automatic_tax.title: Automatic Tax

ip_address.description: A recent IP address of the customer used for tax reporting and tax location inference.
ip_address.title: Ip Address

location.description: The customer's location as identified by Stripe Tax.
location.title: Location

country.description: The customer's country as identified by Stripe Tax.
country.title: Country

source.title: Source

state.description: The customer's state, county, province, or region as identified by Stripe Tax.
state.title: State
